issues: Claim that game tempo is chaotic with balanced control contradicts pulse_team_on_top fact stating 'neither team' is on top, which means no control by either side, not balanced control.
Headline 'Mensah-Cole's sharp strike extends lead' implies the lead was extended, but facts show the score is 1-0, so this was the opening goal, not an extension.
Phrase 'boosting Ashvale Rovers' advantage' suggests a growing lead, but the lead is only 1-0, so wording should reflect opening or initial lead rather than extension or boost.

Claim that Kestrel Bay FC hold 49.4% possession is misleading since overall home possession is 50.6% and away possession is 49.4%, so possession is nearly even rather than Kestrel Bay FC holding it
Claim 'Despite being a man up after the red card' invents context about a red card not stated in facts; facts only show player advantage but no mention of red card or cause

cards.title: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores
cards.headline: Mensah-Cole’s hat-trick seals Ashvale lead
cards.story: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores his third goal with a powerful finish from close range, extending Ashvale Rovers' lead to 3-2. Despite Kestrel Bay FC's push with 10 men and nearly equal possession, Ashvale's numerical advantage and clinical finishing prove decisive in this tightly contested match.

cards.title: Ashvale Rovers turn up the press
cards.headline: Ashvale Rovers intensify press to secure lead
cards.story: With one player advantage and 51% possession, Ashvale Rovers ramp up their pressing, winning 10 turnovers in the last five minutes. Despite a contested tempo and high chaos, their overwhelming control and 3-2 lead put Kestrel Bay FC under immense pressure, likely sealing the win.
